name: Malfunctions: Cyberaudio, cyberoptics & related borgware
description: Breaking Your Stuff, p.7. A short summary by Neon At Home; the DLC has the full text. Import this table and edit it to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy.

results.text: Junk data: -1 to Checks that need sight (cyberoptics) or hearing (cyberaudio), until you spend an Action clearing it. (For 1 minute)
Warped perception: -1 to Checks involving spatial awareness (cyberoptics) or balance (cyberaudio). (For 1 minute)
Lost definition: you see only in black and white or one colour (cyberoptics), or hear a constant ringing (cyberaudio). (For 1 hour)
Worn circuit: no wireless connection to anything but its installed options (Agents, Chipware Sockets, linked tracers...). (For 1 hour)
Rogue option: a switched-off option turns on and can't be shut off: -2 to Checks that need sight or hearing. (For 1 Round)
No faces, no voices: you can't recognise anyone by their face (cyberoptics) or voice (cyberaudio). (For 1 hour)
